audience: website owners and marketers who track their sites with Plausible Analytics

useCases.title: Compare visitors between two periods
useCases.text: The AI reads totals for the metrics you name over two date ranges and compares them, for example this month and last month.

useCases.title: Find your top pages
useCases.text: The AI breaks metrics down by page, for example by visitors, and lists the top ones for the date range you choose.

useCases.title: See where your traffic comes from
useCases.text: The AI breaks metrics down by source and by other properties. You see which sources bring the most visitors.

useCases.title: Check how traffic changed over time
useCases.text: The AI reads metrics grouped by a time interval and describes the trend, with peaks and dips.

useCases.title: See how many visitors are on your site now
useCases.text: The AI reads the number of current visitors, active in the last 5 minutes, for one of your sites.
